s: Tzarik sheyyihyeh lo kavvana bitpillato ubo h' seipim: machashabto ketzad? Hammitpallel tzarik sheyyekavven belibbo perush hammillot shemmotzi bispatayv, shenneemar: "takin libbam taqshib ozneka". Vetzarik sheyyireh atzmo keillu shekina sheruya kenegdo. Veyair hakkavvana veyasir kol hammachashabot hattoredot oto, ad shettishshaer machashabto vekavvanato zakka bitpillato. Veyachashob ki illu haya medabber lipne melek basar vadam haya mesadder debarayv umekavven bahem yapeh lebal yikkashel — qal vachomer lipne melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh baruk hu, shetztzarik lekavven lepanayv ap machashabto, ki lepanayv hammachashaba kedibbur, ki kol hammachashabot hu choqer. Vekak hayu osim chasidim veanshe maaseh shehayu mitbodedim umekavvenim bitpillatam ad shehayu maggiim lehitpashshetut haggashmiyyut ulehitgabberut ruach hassikliyyut ad shehayu maggiim qarob lemaalat hannebua. Veim tabo lo machashaba acheret betok hattepilla — yishtoq ad shettitbattel hammachashaba. Veim eno yakol lekavven perush hammillot — al kol panim tzarik sheyyachashob bishat hattepilla bidbarim hammakniim et halleb umekavvenim libbo leabiv shebbashshamayim. Velo yachshob bidbarim sheyyesh bahem qallut rosh. Veqodem hattepilla yachashob meromemut hael yitbarak veshiplut haadam, veyasir kol taanuge adam millibbo. Veen lenashsheq banayv haqqetannim bebet hakkeneset, kede liqboa belibbo sheen ahaba keahabat hammaqom baruk hu. Viladim hambalbelim abotehem battepilla — en lahabiam kelal lebet hakkeneset:

Lo yitpallel lo bemaqom sheyyesh bo dabar shemmebattel kavvanato, kegon bemaqom sheyyesh shekar chadash shemmeriach, velo beshaa shemmebattelet kavvanato, sheen dato meyushshebet alayv meezeh tzaar o kaas o mittorach hadderek. Veakshav en anu nizharin bekol zeh, mippene sheen anu mekavvenim kol kak battepilla:

Al yaaseh tepillato qeba ella rachamim vetachanunim lipne hammaqom baruk hu. Dehaynu, shello yitpallel mippene hachiyyub kede latzet yede chobato, sheaz tepillato doma alayv kemassaoy umebaqqesh lippater mimmenna, ella kemi shetztzarik dabar uba lebaqqesh millipne hammelek. Vegam yomrenna bilshon tachanunim, kerash hambaqqesh bappetach:

Hattepilla hi bimqom qorban. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shettehe dugmat haqqorban bekavvana, veshello yeareb bah machashaba acheret kemo machashaba shepposelet baqqodashim, utehe meummad kemo aboda, uqebiut maqom kemo haqqorbanot shekkol echad qabua meqomo lishchitato umattan damo, veshello yachotz dabar beno laqqir kemo haqqorban shechatzitza poselet beno lakkeli. Verauy sheyyihyeh lo malbushim naim meyuchadim litpilla kemo bigde kehunna, ella sheen kol adam yakol lebazbez al zeh. Umikkol maqom, tob sheyyihyu lo miknasayim meyuchadim litpilla, mishshum neqiyyut (ap al pi shemmin haddin en tzarik neqiyyut litpilla yoter mittalmud tora, sheap al pi shehammiknasayim meluklakim mibbipnim — muttar, kemo shennitbaer siman a"v):

Al yachashob rauy ani sheyyaaseh haqqadosh baruk hu baqqashati kevan shekkivvanti battepilla, ki adderabba zehu mazkir avonotayv shel adam, sheal yede kak mepashpeshim bemaasayv lomar batuach hu bizkuyyotayv, ella yachashob sheyyaaseh haqqadosh baruk hu bechasdo, veyomar belibbo: mi ani dal venibzeh ba lebaqqesh meet melek malke hammelakim haqqadosh baruk hu im lo merob chasadayv shehu mitnaheg bahem im beriyyotayv:
